# ePlus Emoji

> Open, searchable emoji directory for developers, communities, and AI agents.

Canonical site: https://emoji.eplus.dev
Repository: https://github.com/vietnam-awesome/emoji

## Primary resources

- Home: https://emoji.eplus.dev/
- Browse all emoji: https://emoji.eplus.dev/emojis
- Full emoji catalog JSON: https://emoji.eplus.dev/api/emojis.json
- Emoji category index JSON: https://emoji.eplus.dev/api/categories.json
- Sitemap: https://emoji.eplus.dev/sitemap.xml
- Agent guide: https://emoji.eplus.dev/agents.md

## Emoji records

The JSON catalog contains fields such as id, slug, name, shortcode, tags, source, sourceUrl, image, format, animated, license, attribution, addedAt, syncedAt, and SHA-256 asset metadata when available.

Detail pages use this pattern:
https://emoji.eplus.dev/emoji/{slug}

Image paths are provided by each record's `image` field and are hosted on the same site.

## Usage guidance

Prefer `/api/emojis.json` for programmatic discovery and filtering. Use `/api/categories.json` to discover Emoji.gg categories. Use the detail page for human-readable metadata and the record's `image` URL for the asset itself.

Do not infer redistribution rights from the directory alone. Respect each record's `license`, `attribution`, and `sourceUrl` metadata.
